children: Russia's liquefied natural gas exports rose to 21.6 million metric tons in the first eight months of 2026, 13.7% higher than in the same period of last year, due to supplies from the Arctic LNG 2 project, preliminary LSEG data showed on Thursday.
The same data showed that supplies from the Arctic LNG 2 project had reached 2.8 million tons in the first eight months of the year.
In August, total Russian exports of LNG rose 29% year-on-year to 2.58 million tons.

The data also showed that Russian LNG exports to Europe in January to August jumped 10.7% year-on-year to 10.3 million tons. In August, they declined to around 0.5 million tons from 0.6 million tons a year earlier.
European Union countries in January gave their final approval to ban Russian gas imports by late 2027.
The data showed that total exports from Novatek's
Yamal LNG plant in the January to August period stood at 12.0 million tons, the same as a year earlier.
, exported 6.2 million tons in the first eight months of the year, down from 6.5 million tons in the same period last year.
